NGINX_INSTALL_METHOD.description: Installation strategy for nginx: 'libscript_native' installs into isolated versioned directories and 'system' delegates to the host OS package manager.

NGINX_WWWROOT_NAME.description: The server_name or domain (e.g., example.com) to serve.

NGINX_WWWROOT_PATH.description: The absolute path to the static document root to serve.

NGINX_WWWROOT_LISTEN.description: The HTTP port Nginx should listen on (defaults to 80).

NGINX_SERVERS_ROOT.description: Directory containing per-site Nginx virtual host configuration files.

LIBSCRIPT_LISTEN_PORT_SECURE.description: Global secure port to listen on

LIBSCRIPT_LISTEN_SOCKET.description: Global unix socket to listen on

NGINX_LISTEN_PORT_SECURE.description: Secure port for NGINX to listen on

NGINX_LISTEN_PORT.description: Port for NGINX to listen on

NGINX_LISTEN_ADDRESS.description: Address for NGINX to listen on

NGINX_LISTEN_SOCKET.description: Unix socket for NGINX to listen on

NGINX_SERVICE_RUN_AS_USER.description: Windows local user account to run the service (leave empty for Network Service)

NGINX_SERVICE_RUN_AS_PASSWORD.description: Password for the local user account (if applicable)

NGINX_SERVICE_NAME.description: Custom name for the Windows Service (allows side-by-side installations)

NGINX_HTTPS_ALWAYS.description: Whether to always redirect to HTTPS.

NGINX_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading nginx binary or archive artifacts.

NGINX_FRAGMENT_CONF.description: Path (absolute or relative to LIBSCRIPT_ROOT_DIR) to a custom Nginx location/server configuration template fragment.

NGINX_LISTEN.description: Listen endpoint (address:port or socket) for nginx.

NGINX_PHP_FPM_LISTEN.description: Listen endpoint (address:port or socket) for nginx.

NGINX_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying nginx available remote releases.

NGINX_SERVER_NAME.description: Virtual host server_name directive (domain or IP) written into generated Nginx site configurations.

NGINX_WWWROOT.description: Document root filesystem directory served by the generated Nginx virtual host or location block.
